threads.body: With indy, this will invoke the `ReflectionHelper.filterInterfaces` method using invokedynamic. If I'm understanding this correctly we have to do this because the ReflectionInstrumentationModule is loaded in its own classloader and is thus not directly accessible to the instrumented class which is in the bootstrap CL. It could be worth adding some javadoc/comments to clarify this for future reference.

replies.body: Your understanding is correct. Added a comment. In boot loader we can't use `exposedClassNames` to make the helper class accessible. An alternative would be to use inline advice in this module.
the class doesn't have to be an advice class, any helper class should work
